editorial: This report includes the trends that stood out today for the first time, without repeating what we have shared in recent days.

items.title: SmartlyDressedGames/U3-SDK
items.summary: SmartlyDressedGames shared the U3-SDK software development kit developed for the open world zombie survival game Unturned as open source. These source codes, prepared in C# language, allow community members to customize and develop the game.

items.title: VoltAgent/awesome-design-md
items.summary: Awesome-design-md is a collection of design documents (DESIGN.md) from popular brand design systems. Using these documents, software agents can create user interfaces (UIs) suitable for projects.

items.title: anthropics/claude-cookbooks
items.summary: Claude cookbooks shared by Anthropics provide practical code examples and Jupyter notebooks for using Claude models. This resource provides a variety of workflow templates to help developers speed up Claude integration into AI applications.

items.title: vxcontrol/pentagi
items.summary: Developed with the Go language, Pentagi offers a system of fully autonomous artificial intelligence agents (AI agents) that can perform complex penetration testing. The system aims to standardize autonomous workflows to detect and exploit vulnerabilities.

items.title: unclecode/crawl4ai
items.summary: Crawl4AI is an open source web crawler and data scraper optimized for large language models. The Python-based tool converts unstructured web data into formats directly usable in AI applications.

items.title: imthenachoman/How-To-Secure-A-Linux-Server
items.summary: This guide on Linux server security brings together the basic configuration steps that must be followed to protect systems against external threats. The constantly updated content offers a practical guide to the best methods that can be applied in server hardening processes.

items.title: EU Parliament greenlights Chat Control 1.0
items.summary: The European Parliament has approved the regulation that aims to scan end-to-end encryption systems in order to detect child abuse materials on digital communication platforms. The decision in question brought about discussions about the confidentiality of private correspondence and the implementation of control mechanisms over security protocols.

items.title: GPT-5.6
items.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-5.6, which focuses on security and performance improvements in large language models. The new model is available via API with improved reasoning capabilities and updated security protocols.

items.title: Show HN: 18 Words
items.summary: 18 Words is a word memorization platform that teaches users just eighteen words every day to improve their daily vocabulary. The interface offers a minimalist design free of distractions to simplify the learning process.

items.title: Postgres rewritten in Rust, now passing 100% of the Postgres regression tests
items.summary: The version of the PostgreSQL database management system, rewritten with the Rust programming language, successfully completes all regression tests. This project brings the database architecture to the Rust ecosystem to increase memory security and take advantage of modern language features.
